The truck cab has a 'Nissan Diesel' badge on the front grille.
The rig appears to be in a used condition with visible dirt and wear.
The rig is equipped with a hydraulic pump and hoses.
The rig is shown in a partially assembled state with the mast folded or retracted.
The truck has a Nigerian license plate.
The photos are watermarked 'LOVE PAUL' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.
